title: laggera viscosa
intro: Laggera viscosa, commonly known as African basil or Wild basil, is a tropical plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing, fever reduction, and the treatment of respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Laggera viscosa include its ability to exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities, as well as its potential to reduce oxidative stress and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Laggera viscosa include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
